summary: Tested the GénéraQuiz palier per-question validation (A), the B2 stock display and the C stats/mastery merge. Backend: the new suite test_iteration53_palier_feedback.py passes 7/7. /start leaks no answer keys and shuffles the options. /answer locks the first answer, rejects a bad index or a foreign question, and returns 400 after submit. A second submit returns 400. /submit ignores answers sent by the client and counts unanswered questions as wrong (5 answered -> 15 mistakes with your_answer=null). A replay after failure gets the same 20 question ids. A 20/20 run unlocks palier 2, palier 3 stays 403, overview best_score and attempts are right, and the leaderboard includes the player. /stats and /progression/me combine classic and palier attempts. cuisine-terroir stock is 19 and bien-vieillir is below 20, and /start there returns 409. The one-time backfill ran (marker 'migration_palier_attempts_v1' inserted=6); the admin's cinema paliers 6 and 7 now have legacy attempts and their user_paliers rows are unchanged. Frontend: a full 20-question palier played in the UI behaves correctly: the number of '✅ Bonne réponse !' equals the final score (6/20), and there are 14 parcours-mistake items. Feedback, the right answer, the explanation and aria-live=polite all show, and options are disabled after validation. Précédente rereads a validated question with its feedback; options stay disabled and there is no Valider button. Abandon confirms and returns to the overview. B2 works: a normal user sees parcours-soon-1 and no stock badge on cuisine-terroir and bien-vieillir; the admin sees '⚠ stock 19/20' plus Bientôt disponible. C works in the UI: after 1 classic quiz (5 questions, free plan) and 1 palier, the dashboard shows 2 quizzes, 4 correct, 16%, and the progression card reads '4 / 25 · 2 quiz'. Dashboard at 390px in Confort+: the Jouer and Parcours buttons are not clipped and there is no horizontal overflow. Landing: with /api/categories slowed by 3 s, no universe or Bientôt card rendered before load.

minor.issue: Does not delete the new palier_attempts collection (routers/auth.py line 258 list). Deleted accounts leave orphan rows: 10 currently in preview, created by test users. GDPR / data-hygiene gap. Add 'palier_attempts' to the cleanup list.

Legacy rows can have created_at=None (admin cinema palier 6) because last_played_at was missing. Harmless for the aggregates, but any later sort or filter on created_at will treat them oddly. Consider falling back to completed_at or now.

issues: The explanation box is nested inside 3 padded containers (card p-6, feedback p-5, explanation p-4), so the text column is about 200px wide and a long explanation needs a lot of scrolling before 'Question suivante' is reachable. Consider less padding on mobile or scrolling the next button into view after validation.
Pre-existing: with the extra 'Admin' menu, the 'Confort +' chip is cut off at the right edge of the header.

action_items: Add 'palier_attempts' to the DELETE /api/auth/account cleanup list in routers/auth.py
Optional: give legacy palier_attempts a non-null created_at fallback
Optional: tighten the padding of the mobile palier feedback / auto-scroll to the next button
Stale test: tests/test_iteration22_secure_progression.py::test_catalog_15_badges expects 15 badges, but there are now 22. Update the expectation.
critical_code_review_comments: palier_answer has no 1..7 palier bounds check and does not check the category of question_id against category_id. It is safe in practice because question_id must be in the stored run's question_ids.
palier_submit skips questions deleted mid-run (no mistake entry), but total is still 20, so mistakes + score can be < 20 in that rare case.
The frontend keeps the run only in React state: a page refresh mid-palier loses it, and the next /start resets run_answers. This is acceptable, but players get no warning.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 new tests; iteration52 suite passes; 1 stale badge-count test in iteration22)
